# Synapse Automate

> Türkiye merkezli kurumsal AI otomasyonu, RevenueOS ve AI-native ürün ekosistemi.

Canonical site: https://synapseautomate.github.io/
Contact: synapseautomate.ai@gmail.com | +90 552 202 98 50

## Primary commercial engine
- RevenueOS: inbound lead qualification, booking, follow-up, CRM and measurement.
- Founder Pilot core: approved knowledge base, 30 FAQ, 8–12 intents/flows, lead score, booking/human handoff, 3 follow-up messages, lead board and 30 test cases.
- Home Services / Roofing is one documented RevenueOS implementation pattern; sector coverage is not exclusive.

## Sector coverage

- E-Commerce

- Home Services / Roofing

## Products and ecosystem
- RevenueOS — primary commercial engine
- AgentReady — product architecture
- Creative — product architecture
- MagnetFlow — product architecture
- VELA — product architecture
- TradeOps Lab — technical research/evaluation lab, not a separate commercial brand
- Kilory — AI nutrition, activity, recipe, habit and social motivation application; investor presentation status: launch-ready
- Kinetra Studios — planned AI product studio
- Kinetra Group — planned umbrella combining product and B2B automation engines

## Trust principles
- Security > accuracy > evidence > usability > aesthetics.
- No fabricated case studies, clients, metrics, guarantees or public links.
- Unknown information remains unverified.
- Critical pricing, payment, contract and sensitive advice require human approval.
- Medical, legal and financial advice is not autonomously provided.
- Minimum data, approved sources, retention/deletion rules and controlled handoff are required.
